# SciCoagent

> SciCoagent builds AI "Scientist Coagents" that automate the repetitive pain points of academic research, so scientists spend more time on real research. The coagents cover literature and PI discovery, manuscript proofreading, and turning published papers into a thesis, with an AI research coworker taking shape. Benjamin, the proofreader, is the live flagship. Built by a PhD student. Main site: https://scicoagent.com.

## Coagents

- **SciCo-search** (https://search.scicoagent.com): find the right literature fast, and surface labs and PIs aligned with your research area and discovery goals.
- **SciCoauthor**: context-aware help with the manuscript itself. Includes Benjamin, an AI proofreader that goes beyond spell-check, plus an aRAG assistant that turns your published papers into thesis-ready chapters.
- **SciCo-work** (ideation stage): an AI scientist coworker to think and build research alongside you. Currently taking shape.

## Benjamin, the proofreader

Benjamin (https://benjamin.scicoagent.com) is the live flagship coagent. It reads LaTeX, Word, plain-text/Markdown, and RTF manuscripts like a meticulous co-author, catching the unit, notation, sign, and equation errors general spell-checkers miss, and returns a full tracked-changes review you accept or reject edit by edit. It never rewrites your science. Full detail, including formats and pricing tiers, is at https://benjamin.scicoagent.com/llms.txt.
